title: B2-09 · Mode and degree of certainty

blocks.text: B2-09 · Mode and degree of certainty

Between the Minister will resign, the Minister may resign, it is likely that the Minister will resign and ... it is not excluded that the Minister resigns... there is all the difference between a news and a hypothesis. The Arabic print has a rich and precise system to scale the certainty: particles ( ⁧قَدْ⁩ , ⁧رُبَّمَا⁩ , ⁧لَعَلَّ⁩ ), expressions with ⁧مِنَ⁩ ( ⁧مِنَ المُرَجَّحِ⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُحْتَمَلِ⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُؤَكَّدِ⁩ ), impersonal verbs ( ⁧يُرَجَّحُ⁩ , ⁧يُعْتَقَدُ⁩ , ⁧يَبْدُو⁩ ), compulsory and waiting formulas ( ⁧يَجِبُ⁩ , ⁧يَنْبَغِي⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُفْتَرَضِ⁩ ). In this unit you build a scale of certainty in Arabic and English, learn to distinguish the possibility from obligation and prediction, and practice not to raise or lower the degree of certainty when you translate or summarize. Three weeks, in parallel with EGY-14 and EGY-15.

rows: B2 · Module B2.2 Attribution and certainty
16–18 hours · three weeks (weeks 190–192), plus the EGY track in separate blocks

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Reference Grammar (G)68), voice synthesis scripts, tutor sessions
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
2. place on a five-step scale the most frequent expressions of certainty in printing;
3. to distinguish the mode of knowledge (probably) from that of duty (need) and waiting (should, is expected);
4. translate each step with the right Italian equivalent, without raising it or lowering it;
5. write a short perspective analysis with explicit and attributed degrees of certainty.
